entities.name: Thomas Aquinas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Italian Dominican friar and philosopher (1225–1274) who synthesized Aristotelian philosophy with Christian theology in the Summa Theologica. His work became the intellectual foundation of Catholic theology and natural law theory.
